rationale: Careers subpage of ukrcard.com.ua; hiring signal belongs to A5 and is covered by monitoring the parent domain; URL check failed.
Major regional processor's own news stream — recurring disclosure of card processing footprint, services and bank clients.
Continuously producing job marketplace with payments filters and annual analytics; weak for A4 statistics but a durable macro hiring indicator.
Public CV database — personal data of identifiable individuals; not a market-statistics source and legally unsafe to collect.
Card-platform vendor product/case-study pages keep producing disclosures of which UA banks run which processing stack.
A work.ua saved-search on generic terminal-engineer vacancies; sibling of the same domain, A5-flavoured, no standalone statistics.
Events section of itukraine.org.ua with siblings on domain; redundant with DOU/psm7 event coverage.
Authoritative NBU payment-infrastructure register: the population list of regulated payment systems, participants and technological operators.
NBU licensing hub for non-bank PSPs and e-money issuers; continuously updated authorisation lists defining the non-bank payments population.
Searchable NBU registers of non-bank financial institutions — the enumeration layer behind most payment/e-money actors.
Likely structured backend of the NBU register search but access/queryability unconfirmed; re-check before committing to monitoring.
Open-data State Register of Banks in XLS — exact bank/branch population and status time series, machine-readable.
NBU open-data hub and REST API — programmable feed of bank/branch directories and statistical reference books.
Register of reporting indicators maps which non-bank actors report which payment/market series — core A4 metadata.
Single NBU news item carrying the annual designation list; valuable evidence, but the news hub/register is the monitorable source.
NBU open-banking hub with the emerging authorised AISP/PISP register — a fast-changing fintech population segment.
Machine-readable DGF member-bank register; independent cross-check and clean bank entry/exit time series.
Historical archive of member-bank snapshots — mine once to reconstruct bank-population history, then archive.
Bulk EDR open data — ownership/identity backbone joinable by EDRPOU to every licensed bank and PSP.
Commercial aggregator with API; useful redundancy but licensing/terms for reuse unclear — clear legal status first.
Sources inventory is a one-off lead mine for undiscovered registers; dossiers themselves are paywalled and URL check failed.
Free-tier register aggregator useful for bulk enrichment, but redundant with EDR open data and terms unclear.
NSSMC half of the State Register of Financial Institutions; needed for completeness though mostly capital-market, off the payments core.
Meta-catalogue of statutory registers — mine once for registers that exist by law but are unsurfaced; URL check failed.
Primary legislation defining register contents and PSP categories — schema reference, not a recurring signal producer.
Legacy NBU directory with outlet-level geography; valuable for history but archival site liveness unverified.
Single FOI request thread; useful as evidence of where register data lives, not a continuous statistics source.
